firstMismatch.message: C accepts the mounted hero and descends; JavaScript refuses next_to_u() with a steed before the level transition.

summary: At the only unmatched screen, a mounted Wizard presses > on a down staircase. C apply.c:next_to_u() returns true for a steed that does not carry the Amulet, so do.c:dodown() calls next_level() and do.c:goto_level() transfers the steed. JavaScript throws at the mounted-steed guard. The required runtime path continues through dog.c:keepdogs() and dog.c:mon_arrive(), whose current JavaScript mounted-steed branches also throw. Implement the source branches as one transfer path; preserve the separate Amulet refusal.

source.branch: After the leash predicate scan, apply.c:next_to_u() returns false only when a leashed follower cannot remain within two squares or when the mounted steed carries the Amulet; otherwise it returns true. For the selected > command, do.c:dodown() reaches this helper on a down staircase, then do.c:goto_level() calls dog.c:keepdogs(FALSE), which moves u.usteed to gm.mydogs. After the new level is built, dog.c:losedogs() calls dog.c:mon_arrive(mtmp, With_you); mon_arrive() links the same u.usteed into fmon and returns before placing it as a separate map occupant.
functions: apply.c:next_to_u() (918-928), the exercised non-Amulet mounted return branch
dog.c:keepdogs() (789-884), its ordinary level-transfer branch for mtmp == u.usteed
dog.c:mon_arrive() (420-623), its mtmp == u.usteed early-return branch after restore_cham()
callers: do.c:dodown() (1251, 1290): the selected > command tests next_to_u() and calls next_level(TRUE).
dungeon.c:next_level() (1497-1514) passes the destination to do.c:goto_level().
do.c:goto_level() (1624, 1816) calls keepdogs(FALSE) before saving the old level and losedogs() after arrival.
dog.c:losedogs() (381-383) drains gm.mydogs through mon_arrive(mtmp, With_you).

Other direct next_to_u() callers are do.c:doup() (1336), do.c:goto_level() (1567), trap.c:dotrap() (643), artifact.c:arti_invoke() (1921), dig.c:dig() (762), teleport.c:level_tele()/tele_trap()/teleds()/teleport_pet() (1145, 1154, 1304, 1453, 1506), and allmain.c:moveloop_core() (313). Existing JavaScript callers use js/apply_next_to_u.js from do.js, trap.js, artifacts.js, dig.js, teleport.js, allmain.js, and cmd.js.
dependencies: The downstream transfer is required because the C true return is consumed by do.c:dodown() and leads directly to goto_level(). JavaScript dog.js:keepdogs() currently throws at the mounted-steed branch; C instead clears mtrapped and meating, calls the already implemented steal.c:mdrop_special_objs(), removes the steed from the departing level, and appends it to gm.mydogs.

The next C caller is dog.c:losedogs(), already wired by do.js:goto_level(). Its With_you path reaches dog.c:mon_arrive(), whose C branch inserts u.usteed into the destination monster list, restores its transfer flags, and returns before mnexto(). JavaScript dog.js currently throws at this same branch.

The separate apply.c:mleashed_next2u() leash branch remains incomplete because its source mnexto() call is synchronous while JavaScript mon.js:mnexto() is asynchronous. The selected session has no leashed companion; the existing callback returns false for every un-leashed monster. Do not claim the leash branch complete.

No active ledger reservation names apply.c:next_to_u, dog.c:keepdogs, or dog.c:mon_arrive. The submitted A2 priest delivery reserves separate priest.c, pray.c, invent.c, mon.c:wakeup, and uhitm.c:hmon functions.
